globalRules: No lane may change fields or pass criteria after source values are observed.
Raw parent receipts precede derived states.
Every parent receipt gets one primitiveReceiptId and immutable source/version/hash clocks.
Derived children reference parentReceiptIds and do not create independent evidence by transformation alone.
PENDING_BY_CLOCK means the frozen source window has not arrived; it is not UNKNOWN, zero, no-event or failure.
UNKNOWN is used only after the source window when the required object cannot be observed or qualified.
Later revisions append vintages and never overwrite earlier observations.
No returns, MFE, MAE, hit rate, ranking or selection outcomes are joined.
No Formal score, rank, Top6, capital or signal behavior changes.
